sources.note: Nothing; 'apparently spurious language.. Nothing is known of the language'; cites only the ISO change request and Hugoniot 1970.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2008. Change Request Number 2008-001: retire [aay] Aariya (submitted by Conrad Hurd, SIL, 2007-09-25; adopted 2009-01-16). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; contains no linguistic data at all. p.2, section 3(c): 'There is no evidence that the language exists.. The only reference for this language is Hugoniot, Richard. 1970.. Hugoniot's source was Madhya Pradesh Dept. of Tribal Welfare, The Tribes of Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal 1964. Aariya was listed as a Scheduled Tribe at that time but not listed in the more recent Anthropological Society of India research on peoples of India edited by K.S. Singh. Surveyors in the area in 2004 found nobody who had even heard of this language.'
Nothing; retired entry kept for bookkeeping, 'non-existent language', effective 2009-01-16, CR 2008-001; zero references.
